verses.1: And you also, O kings and princes, hear my words and keep my commandments, says the Lord who rules over all, how the children of Israel provoked me and served foreign gods, though I am the Lord your God, who kept you and saved you and delivered you from their enemies and blessed them in all that they desired.
verses.2: And I brought them up into a mighty land, and blessed them with the blessing of the land, with trees that bear fruit and vines that they planted, and with the pressing of oil and the flowing of sweet water that they did not dig.
verses.3: And with honey dripping, and the milk of sheep together with the butter of cattle, and garments of fine linen, and everything that was desired for them.
verses.4: And there was nothing that I withheld from them of all that they asked of me.
